Have Compassion on Them Missions

Reach. Disciple.
Stand alongside.

Our mission brings together gospel outreach, grassroots discipleship, the training of workers, and practical support for missionaries.

Restore discipleship

Encourage believers to make disciples in their everyday communities and help others grow in their walk with Christ.

Revive the missionary spirit

Awaken a renewed burden for souls through going, praying, and supporting those on the mission field.

Reach the unreached

Bring the gospel to unreached people and places, with practical care for missionaries and suffering saints.

The work of discipleship

HCTM has a network of missionaries across the states engaged in discipleship, alongside student missionaries undergoing training. We seek more believers willing to go, serve, and help others come to know Christ.

We encourage believers to become fruitful in their own communities and stand alongside those carrying the gospel to unreached people and places.

Care for those who go

Missionaries need faithful prayer, food, shelter, and financial support as they serve. We invite believers who share this burden to discuss current needs with the ministry.
